notes.title: 2022 Chip Pack Price Changes
notes.notes:
To our Four Kings players,

Beginning on September 12th, 2022, the price of chip packages will be increasing on all platforms. Since The Four Kings Casino and Slots launched in 2015, we have continued to maintain the same chip package prices we launched with. Due to a variety of market forces out of our control, we are reluctantly adjusting our pricing to continue to provide you with a consistent gaming experience.

Players will have from now until September 12th to buy chips at their current price before the new pricing structure takes effect. On average, there will be a 10% increase for all chip packages available from the Cashier. All other in-game purchases will maintain their current prices, including clothing items and Emporium store items. VIP levels will continue to grant extra bonus chips from purchases based on your VIP level, up to 15% additional chips for VIP 3 players.

Thank you for your continued support.

Also new this Spring - Blackjack and Slot Tournament Events will now be held in the Event Room! When these are events are active, simply load up the Map and warp to the Event Room, where you can play directly with all of your fellow competitors.

This is just the first of many new updates we plan for 2018 so make sure you follow us on [url=www.facebook.com/fourkingscasino]Facebook[/url] and on [url=www.twitter.com/digitalleisure]Twitter[/url] for the latest.

notes.title: Update 1.052 - Poker Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Version 1.052[/h1]
We are pleased to announce the rollout of the much anticipated ability to reconnect to an in-progress poker game if accidentally disconnected.  Any player disconnected from the table will be able to rejoin his/her table as long as his/her chips are still in play.   Please note, if you disconnect from the table using ESC, no reconnection options will be available.

[h1]What to Expect After A Poker Disconnection:[/h1]

The disconnected player will attempt to reconnect and his/her chips will remain in play.  Small and large blinds will be automatically paid, and the player will automatically check if the check option is available.  The hand will fold to any chip increase that would normally require player intervention (such as a bet or raise).  It is possible that if a player has the big blind, and no one raises during the hand, for the player to win a hand while disconnected.  [b]If the player runs out of chips while disconnected then he/she will not see the option to rejoin the table upon reconnection.[/b]  Running out of chips during the reconnection process will also halt the reconnection and the player will no longer be able to rejoin the table.

[h1]Reconnection Process In Game:[/h1]

Once the player logs back in, he/she will be automatically transported back to the poker table.  It will NOT be possible to go anywhere other than the poker table.  Attempts to teleport to any other location will result in being transported back to the poker table.  Once at the poker table, the icon above the table will say “Wait”.  Once the hand currently in progress completes, the icon will then provide the option to “Join”.  Once the player elects to join, a blue box will appear that says “Waiting” while the next hand plays out.  Once that second hand plays out, the player will be seated at the table, and play will resume.


Thank you to all those who assisted in the beta testing of this function. If you experience any issues during the reconnection process, please provide as much detail as possible via a bug report or forum post so we may review and correct it.

notes.notes:
[h1]Major Slot Update[/h1]

[b]Spinning Cogs Released![/b]
It's your duty to take down the enemy airships and earn big bonuses. When the three Scatter Airships appear on your board, prepare to fire up your weapons. But watch out for Steambots - or your bonus round is sunk.

[b]888 Slots Bonus Round Payout Error[/b]
This issue affects ~250 active 888 Slot users. If you are not an active slot player, you can likely ignore.

On Monday June 29th, a bug was introduced during the V1.017 patch at 18:00 EDT. The bug caused the player to be re-awarded all previous slot session winnings upon achieving a 888 Bonus round. This doubled all of the session winnings - something that should not have occurred. The bug was reported by a small number of users and we began to investigate. Upon discovering the true nature of the bug and irregular payouts, we had no choice but to shut down the game servers. 

The following updates must now instituted to ensure the fairness and continuity of the game.
[list]
[*]New players - those who started playing the game for the first time following Monday's update - will have their slot winnings capped at 25,000 chips.[/*]

[*]Existing players who earned chips while playing the slots during this error period will have their winning chips capped at 100,000. All others that earned below 100,000 chips during this period will keep what they won.[/*]

[*]All RP gained will be kept as earned for all players. This will not be deducted due to the error.[/*]

[*]The Slots Leaderboard has been reverted to the state prior to Monday's update, and all Global earnings from Slot gains have also be reverted.[/*]

[*]Accounts which had earned the Level 40 Slots Steampunk outfit after Monday's update, no longer have this item in inventory. (This affected ~6 users).[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.9026
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch Notes v0.9026[/h1]
[b]The day the numbers changed.[/b]
We’ve made a change to all the limits within the Casino. Everything will be 10x the value it was before. From a balance perspective, this doesn’t really affect things – games will cost 10x as much, but you also have 10x as many chips. We’re making this change because based on some feedback we’ve received, users didn’t feel like the limits were high enough. Originally when designing the game, we thought that going into a casino and dropping $200 a hand was a lot, we felt each chip was pretty valuable and even winning 100-200 chips was rewarding. While that may be the case in real life, we want to make this feel a bit more like a game. So now anyone can walk in and start betting thousands of chips/hand, with the limits in VIP reaching up to 10,000. Functionally everything should be the same, but we feel this is more fun and rewarding.

This change does affect a lot of areas throughout the casino though, so it’s possible we missed something. If you notice something hasn’t been properly scaled, please report a bug or post in the discussion area of our community hub. We’d also love to hear your feedback on the new system.
Some things to look out for:
[list]	[*]Chip models have updated to reflect the new chip values, so make sure the chips you bet correspond to the chips on the table[/*]	[*]RP will still be earned at the same rate for each game (i.e. not multiplied by 10).[/*]	[*]Make sure you’re being awarded the appropriate chip values from things like gifts, daily slot spins and free chips.[/*]	[*]Make sure you’re being paid out correctly on bets.[/*]	[*]Make sure your holdings are correct[/*]	[*]Purchasing chips should also be multiplied by 10x.[/*][/list]
[b]Other changes this patch:[/b]
[list]	[*]Users with new accounts should be randomly assigned a UI color[/*]	[*]The game should adjust resolutions a little more cleanly now[/*]	[*]Fixed a bug where you sometimes could not add a friend by name until you selected someone on your friends list[/*]	[*]Fixed an issue where settings were not sticking. If you find settings changing randomly changing, please take note and file a bug report.[/*]	[*]Fixed some issues around gifting a guest pass. You can send a VIP guest pass to your friends via the cash terminal[/*]	[*]Fixed some issues loading categories in the store.[/*]	[*]Fixed some issues around block-list logic[/*]	[*]Fixed an issue where the message of the day would not always be the most recent MOTD[/*]	[*]Fixed a number of issues regarding tournaments[/*][/list]
[b]Known Issues:[/b]
[list]	[*]X/Y Inversion may not be set correctly when you first start the game.[/*]	[*]Task Tracker does not properly scroll to read the whole task.[/*][/list]
[b]Localization:[/b]
[list]	[*]We’ve started localizing in Greek![/*][/list]

We’ve updated a lot of the underlying mechanics for our lighting system within the Casino. This is good because it will allow us more power and flexibility in the future, but currently the lights look a little bit off.

[h1]Release Notes (03/03/2015)[/h1]
As many of you know we rolled out a lot of updates a bit hastily last week. This resulted in quite a few stability issues for many table games. We’ve since gone back and addressed those issues again, so most of the fixes are in now and should be working properly.

If this happens, please close the game (Alt + F4) and try again.[/*][/list]

[list]	[*]Resolution settings should be remembered and set correctly now.[/*]	[*]We have a new profanity filter which has been working a lot better. Try it out, but still be polite![/*]	[*]We are starting to implement the friends list, its not done yet, but the skeleton is there.[/*]	[*]When exiting the game you have the option to quit completely, or log out.[/*]	[*]Ambient music! Sounds for slots and video poker![/*][/list]
